# evroc_vpc (Resource)

Provides an evroc Virtual Private Cloud (VPC) resource for network isolation.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the VPC. Must be unique within the project.

### Optional

- `ipv4_cidr_blocks` (List of String) IPv4 CIDR blocks for the VPC. Must be within RFC 1918 ranges. Defaults to ["10.0.0.0/16"].
- `project` (String) Project this resource belongs to. Defaults to the provider project.
- `region` (String) Region where the VPC is created. Defaults to provider region.
- `stack_type` (String) Stack type: 'dual-stack' (IPv4 + IPv6) or 'ipv6-only'. Defaults to dual-stack.
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))
- `user_labels` (Map of String) User-defined labels (key/value pairs) for organizing and selecting resources.

### Read-Only

- `assigned_ipv4_cidr_blocks` (List of String) IPv4 CIDR blocks actually assigned to the VPC.
- `assigned_ipv6_gua_block` (String) Publicly routable IPv6 range assigned to the VPC.
- `available_ipv4_cidr_blocks` (List of String) IPv4 CIDR blocks still available (not allocated) in the VPC.
- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the VPC was created (RFC3339 format).
- `fqid` (String) Fully qualified resource ID (FQID). Use this to reference this resource from other resources.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `subnets` (List of Object) Subnets allocated within this VPC. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--subnets))
- `system_labels` (Map of String) System-managed labels automatically set by evroc (read-only).
- `vpc_id` (String) Unique identifier (UUID) of the VPC.
